backxwash.bio: Zambian-Canadian rapper and producer Ashanti Mutinta, known as Backxwash, is based in Montréal and makes dark, boundary-pushing doom rap.

charlotte day wilson.bio: Toronto-born Canadian contemporary R&B singer-songwriter known for the song Work, the album Cyan Blue, and collaborations across Toronto's jazz, soul, and alternative-R&B scenes.

daniel caesar.bio: Toronto-born Canadian singer-songwriter whose gospel-rooted, atmospheric R&B helped make him one of the country's most internationally recognized contemporary voices.

feist.bio: Leslie Feist is a Canadian indie-pop singer-songwriter, solo artist, and member of Broken Social Scene, recognized for intimate songwriting and distinctive vocal work.

haviah mighty.bio: Toronto-born, Brampton-based hip-hop artist known for incisive lyricism, forceful delivery, and work that challenges gendered expectations in Canadian rap.

jessie reyez.bio: Toronto-based Colombian-Canadian singer-songwriter recognized for raw, emotionally direct vocals and genre-blending R&B and pop songwriting.

kaytranada.bio: Haitian-Canadian producer and DJ Louis Kevin Celestin, raised in Montréal, whose groove-heavy production bridges house, hip-hop, funk, R&B, and electronic music.

nelly furtado.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter whose multilingual, genre-fluid catalogue spans pop, R&B, hip-hop, dance, and Portuguese-influenced sounds.

snotty nose rez kids.bio: Indigenous Canadian hip-hop duo Yung Tryz and Young D, known for sharp storytelling, West Coast perspective, cultural pride, and socially conscious rap.

the halluci nation.bio: Ottawa-founded Indigenous electronic and hip-hop collective formerly known as A Tribe Called Red, blending powwow music with club production and political, community-rooted expression.

drake.bio: Toronto-born rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor whose work has made him one of the most commercially influential Canadian artists of the streaming era.

the weeknd.bio: Scarborough-born Canadian singer-songwriter Abel Tesfaye, known for atmospheric R&B, pop songwriting, and a distinctive falsetto.

justin bieber.bio: London, Ontario-born Canadian singer and songwriter who became a global pop figure after emerging online as a teenager.

alessia cara.bio: Mississauga-born Canadian singer-songwriter whose candid pop and R&B helped establish her as an important contemporary Canadian voice.

shawn mendes.bio: Pickering-born Canadian singer-songwriter who built an early online following before becoming an internationally recognized pop artist.

arcade fire.bio: Montréal-founded Canadian indie-rock band known for expansive arrangements, energetic performances, and internationally acclaimed albums.

chromeo.bio: Montréal electro-funk duo formed by Dave 1 and P-Thugg, blending funk, synth-pop, disco, and R&B influences.

arkells.bio: Hamilton-formed Canadian rock band whose catalogue combines arena-ready songwriting with a strong hometown identity and community focus.

city and colour.bio: The solo project of Canadian singer-songwriter Dallas Green, known for introspective acoustic songwriting and work connected to Alexisonfire.

carly rae jepsen.bio: Mission, British Columbia-born Canadian singer-songwriter known for bright, meticulously crafted pop and the global hit Call Me Maybe.

alanis morissette.bio: Ottawa-born singer-songwriter, producer, actor, and activist known for confessional rock songwriting.

avril lavigne.bio: Belleville-born Canadian singer-songwriter whose pop-punk catalogue made her an international star.

bryan adams.bio: Kingston-born Canadian singer-songwriter, guitarist, and photographer with a career spanning rock and pop.

céline dion.bio: Charlemagne, Québec-born singer recognized for powerful vocals and one of the most successful international careers in popular music.

shania twain.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter whose country-pop catalogue made her one of the best-selling artists in music history.

sarah mclachlan.bio: Halifax-born singer-songwriter known for emotionally direct pop, adult contemporary, and folk-influenced music.

tegan and sara.bio: Calgary-born twin sisters whose indie-rock and pop songwriting has earned a lasting international audience.

metric.bio: Toronto-based Canadian alternative-rock band led by Emily Haines and James Shaw.

billy talent.bio: Mississauga-formed Canadian rock band known for its melodic, high-energy punk and alternative-rock sound.

blue rodeo.bio: Toronto country-rock band whose rootsy songwriting and long-running catalogue are central to Canadian popular music.

the tragically hip.bio: Kingston-formed Canadian rock band celebrated for distinctive storytelling and deep national cultural impact.

our lady peace.bio: Toronto alternative-rock band fronted by Raine Maida, known for a catalogue spanning post-grunge, alternative rock, and art rock.

mother mother.bio: Vancouver-formed Canadian alternative-rock band known for layered vocal harmonies and genre-blending songwriting.

the beaches.bio: Toronto rock band whose sharp, energetic songs have made them one of Canada's prominent contemporary guitar acts.

simple plan.bio: Montréal-formed pop-punk band known for melodic, emotionally direct songs and a global fanbase.

sum 41.bio: Ajax, Ontario-formed rock band that combined pop-punk, punk, and metal influences across an internationally successful catalogue.

k-os.bio: Canadian rapper, singer, songwriter, and producer known for combining hip-hop with rock, soul, reggae, and pop.

classified.bio: Enfield, Nova Scotia-born rapper and producer whose work is rooted in Canadian hip-hop and East Coast identity.

maestro fresh wes.bio: Toronto rapper and producer widely regarded as a foundational figure in Canadian hip-hop.

lights.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and visual artist known for electronic pop and alternative music.

a-trak.bio: Montréal-born DJ, producer, and label founder known for bridging turntablism, hip-hop, house, and electronic music.

amanda marshall.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter known for powerful pop-rock vocals and emotionally direct songs.

andy shauf.bio: Regina-born Canadian singer-songwriter whose detailed narrative writing blends indie folk and alternative pop.

badbadnotgood.bio: Toronto instrumental group known for combining jazz with hip-hop, electronic, and alternative influences.

bahamas.bio: The musical project of Toronto singer-songwriter Afie Jurvanen, known for understated, guitar-led indie and folk-pop.

basia bulat.bio: Montréal-based Canadian singer-songwriter known for intimate folk-pop songwriting and expressive vocals.

bif naked.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter, poet, actor, and author associated with alternative rock and punk.

big wreck.bio: Toronto-formed rock band led by singer-songwriter and guitarist Ian Thornley.

broken social scene.bio: Toronto indie-rock collective known for expansive arrangements and a collaborative Canadian music community.

buck 65.bio: Canadian rapper, producer, and broadcaster known for inventive storytelling and roots-oriented hip-hop.

cadence weapon.bio: Edmonton-born rapper and author known for socially observant lyrics and inventive electronic hip-hop.

chantal kreviazuk.bio: Winnipeg-born Canadian singer-songwriter and pianist known for pop, adult contemporary, and film songwriting.

coeur de pirate.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Béatrice Martin, known for French-language piano-pop and intimate songwriting.

connor price.bio: Canadian rapper and songwriter known for concise, high-energy hip-hop releases and short-form music content.

deborah cox.bio: Toronto-born Canadian singer, songwriter, and actor known for powerhouse R&B and soul vocals.

dear rouge.bio: Vancouver husband-and-wife alternative-pop duo known for synth-driven songwriting and energetic performances.

dragonette.bio: Toronto electro-pop group founded by Martina Sorbara and Dan Kurtz, known for dance-pop songwriting.

esthero.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter and producer whose work blends trip-hop, soul, jazz, and alternative pop.

great big sea.bio: Newfoundland and Labrador folk-rock band known for bringing traditional Atlantic Canadian influences to a broad audience.

grimes.bio: Vancouver-born Canadian musician, singer-songwriter, producer, and visual artist associated with electronic and experimental pop.
